fixture.bounds: At most two episodes, twelve events each. Proposed smallest behavioral fixture has teach, before ask, correction, corrected ask, fresh multihop ask and missing-fact ask per episode. Human source verifier supplies literal text and accepted strings; no fixtures are fabricated here.
fixture.freshness: Fixture owner records exclusion from every selected checkpoint training set and prior development use. Without that check, report development output only, never fresh generalization.
fixture.notebook: Append literal teaching and correction bytes in source order. Never delete or resolve stale statements by hand. Question text is not appended as notebook knowledge; assistant output never becomes source material.
fixture.limits: Reject empty questions, questions above48 tokenizer tokens and notebooks above512 tokens before the existing truncating tokenizer runs. No automatic cropping or retrieval.
fixture.provenance_limit: A pinned origin declaration does not independently establish human authorship. Root must verify source_ref and release the episodes before an actual behavior run.

bounded_matrix.plain: Full arm using compatible existing plain checkpoint; skip with explicit unavailable reason if no compatible checkpoint. It is not a parameter-matched scaling proof.
bounded_matrix.account: Two episodes times four asks times six loop arms plus one plain arm times two seeds =112 native generation calls. This is a proposal, not a launch or prerequisite for the priority256-row run.
bounded_matrix.controls: Missing-fact asks require a human accepted abstention. Pre-correction context should retain the original answer where applicable; updated context should produce the corrected answer. Score these directions separately using the corresponding full-arm before and after rows. No-notebook, zero-final and reader-only successes weaken notebook/core dependence claims. Reversal is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a guarantee of disabling reasoning.
bounded_matrix.pass_fail: Per arm: PASS only if every generated answer matches a literal human accepted answer and native generation records valid observed terminal EOS and strip parity. Exact text matching can reject valid paraphrases; no model judge or arithmetic solver is used. English grammar and semantic equivalence remain independent human review fields.
bounded_matrix.attribution: System answer success is not reasoner-specific proof. Frozen reader/talker can compute; residual-information and off-distribution controls do not conclusively locate reasoning. No fair advantage, notebook correctness or scaling qualification is inferred from these counts.
